name: Kojima Arisu
source:
[url=/c95232]Mikado's[/url] childhood friend and [url=/c22136]Neneko's[/url] younger sister. She enjoys doing art and loves working at the café her parents own. Very sweet and kind her bedroom window faces Mikado's and they say goodnight to each other every day. She loves Mikado and wants to be part of his [url=/v5932]Mecha-con[/url] someday so she and her sister will always be together.

Term of endearment for her [url=/c95232]husband[/url] 'Papa', since they will have children someday.
translation:
[url=/c95232]帝[/url]的青梅竹马，也是[url=/c22136]音音子[/url]的妹妹。她喜欢画画，也喜欢在父母经营的咖啡馆工作。她非常温柔善良，卧室窗户正对着帝的房间，两人每天都会互道晚安。她爱着帝，希望有一天成为他的[url=/v5932]机甲婚[/url]成员，这样就能永远和姐姐待在一起。

她对[url=/c95232]丈夫[/url]的爱称是“爸爸”，因为她们将来会有孩子。
